mentions.name: Model Style not-a-Bench
mentions.description: This is a benchmark-alternative tool for quickly eyeballing and comparing various LLMs, with a focus on 4-bit quantized models under 100GB of weights (excluding storage offload approaches), letting users judge models' stylistic choices directly rather than relying on benchmark scores.
mentions.problem: Recent LLMs release with very promising benchmarks but disappoint by failing simple tasks or sanity checks, and benchmarks don't reveal the models' stylistic choices.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I made 'Model Style not-a-Bench' to be able to quickly eyeball various LLMs, most preferably at 4-bit quants, under 100GB weights (excluding storage offloads like Qwen Flash Next's approach).

evidence.value: So I made 'Model Style not-a-Bench' to be able to quickly eyeball various LLMs, most preferably at 4-bit quants, under 100GB weights (excluding storage offloads like Qwen Flash Next's approach).
